summary: A roundup of standout high school sports moments from September 2023 through May across football, cross country, volleyball, basketball, wrestling, swimming, track and soccer. Each section spotlights a student athlete and ties the performance to a life lesson. It closes with advice for parents on supporting young athletes through dialogue, resilience and sportsmanship.
one_line: Season recap of local high school athletic highlights across eight sports, with parent advice on supporting young athletes.
key_facts: On September 8, the Jefferson High Jaguars beat the Lincoln High Spartans in the football season opener with a last-minute 36-yard touchdown pass from quarterback Mike Thompson to wide receiver Tyler Woods.
On September 23, the Annual Cross Country Invitational was held at Eastwood High School grounds.
Junior Vanessa Laine of Westside Academy won the individual title at the Annual Cross Country Invitational with a record-breaking time.
On October 11, senior Annabelle Lee of North River High led her team to victory at the volleyball Midseason Classic with 21 kills and 18 digs.
On November 15, South Valley Flyers shooting guard Chris Dunkin sank three consecutive three-pointers in the final minutes against the Metro Tech Knights.
On December 3, sophomore Carla Mendez of Central High won her weight class at the regional wrestling championships against more experienced wrestlers.
At the Annual Aquatic Gala on January 21, Oliver Green of the Riverside High Sharks broke two regional records and led his relay team to a win.
On February 12, Rachel Kim of Eastside Prep shattered the district record for the 100-meter dash as track and field season began.
On May 5, junior striker Miguel Sanchez scored a hat trick as the Easton High Eagles beat the Greenwood High Raiders 3-2.
The note advises parents to keep open dialogue with their child, teach resilience in defeat, and emphasize sportsmanship, and to balance sports with academics.
